hooks.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); echo "$input" | grep -qE "\\$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT.*(rm[[:space:]]+-rf|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+--force|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|DROP[[:space:]]+TABLE)" && { echo "BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다" >&2; exit 1; }; exit 0'
bash -c 'if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/token-report.js" ]; then node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/token-report.js" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude" 2>/dev/null | tail -2; fi' || true
